cases.title: Short phone number blocks Next
cases.description: With fewer than 10 digits the Next button stays disabled; the 10th digit enables it.

cases.title: Wrong OTP shows an error
cases.description: A wrong verification code shows an error and keeps you on the OTP screen.

cases.title: Name screen is required
cases.description: A first-time user lands on the Name screen after OTP; Continue stays disabled while the name is empty or only spaces.

cases.title: Name is capped at 50 characters
cases.description: Typing 60 characters leaves exactly 50 in the name field.

cases.title: Back from Referral to edit the name
cases.description: Going back from the Referral screen returns to the Name screen; the edited name carries forward.

cases.title: Partial referrer number blocks Continue
cases.description: A referrer number that isn't 10 digits keeps Continue disabled.

cases.title: Own number as referrer is rejected
cases.description: Entering your own number as the referrer shows an error and keeps you on the screen.

cases.title: Unknown referrer is rejected
cases.description: A number that isn't an active JewelChat account shows an error.

cases.title: Valid referrer is accepted
cases.description: An active account's number is accepted as the referrer and sign-up finishes on the chat list.

cases.title: Skip referral; next sign-in goes straight in
cases.description: A second new account skips the referral; after signing out and back in it goes straight to the chat list because its name was kept.

cases.title: Sign in as the test device
cases.description: Fresh install: phone, OTP, (name/referral if needed), chat list. Every later case depends on it.

cases.title: Receive a message
cases.description: A bot message shows in the list and the thread; the device sends a delivery receipt, then a read marker once the chat is open.

cases.title: Send a message
cases.description: A device message reaches the bot as a text message; the bubble is addressable by the same id.

cases.title: Offline send queue
cases.description: A message sent in airplane mode isn't delivered until the network returns, then arrives.

cases.title: Reconnect keeps incoming working
cases.description: After an airplane-mode drop and after a background/foreground cycle, incoming messages are still stored, shown and receipted (handler-wipe regression).

cases.title: Typing indicator
cases.description: The bot's composing/paused states show and clear "typing…" in the header.

cases.title: Reply both ways
cases.description: A bot reply shows the quote; the device's reply carries the right parent id.

cases.title: Reaction from the bot
cases.description: A bot reaction renders a pill under the device's message.

cases.title: Presence
cases.description: The bot going online/offline changes the header to "Online" and back.

cases.title: Burst of 20 messages
cases.description: 20 back-to-back messages all arrive, in order, with no duplicates.

cases.title: Duplicate message id
cases.description: A stanza re-sent with the same id is stored once; the first copy wins.

cases.title: Long, multi-line, emoji and RTL text
cases.description: A 2000-character, a multi-line, an emoji and an Arabic message render intact; a 300-character device message reaches the bot whole.

cases.title: Whitespace-only message is not sent
cases.description: Typing only spaces and tapping send delivers nothing.

cases.title: Reaction replaced, then cleared
cases.description: A reaction can be swapped for another emoji and then removed; the pill follows.

cases.title: Reply to a message we never had
cases.description: A reply quoting an unknown message shows without a quote and nothing crashes.

cases.title: Forwarded label
cases.description: A message marked forwarded shows the Forwarded label.

cases.title: Typing clears when the message lands
cases.description: "typing…" disappears as soon as the message arrives, even without a paused state.

cases.title: Three offline messages flush in order
cases.description: Three messages written in airplane mode are delivered in the order they were written.

cases.title: Read marker only after opening
cases.description: A message that only reaches the chat list gets a delivery receipt but no read marker until the chat is opened.

cases.title: Star, delete, pin, archive, delete chat
cases.description: Star shows in Starred; delete-for-me removes only our copy; pin and archive/unarchive move the row; deleting the conversation clears it and a new message brings it back empty.

cases.title: Forward to two chats
cases.description: One message forwarded to two bots reaches both, marked as forwarded.

cases.title: Background catch-up
cases.description: Messages sent while the app is in the background all appear, in order, when it returns.

cases.title: Message while the app was killed
cases.description: A message sent while the app was force-stopped should appear after relaunch.
cases.knownIssue: Not fetched: catch-up only runs from the last background time (README "Not fixed").

cases.title: Unknown sender prompt
cases.description: A message from someone not in the phonebook opens with the prompt (formatted number, Add / Block / Continue) instead of the composer.

cases.title: Continue, reply, prompt stays gone
cases.description: Continue opens the composer, a reply reaches the stranger, and the prompt doesn't return after a restart.

cases.title: Block survives restart; Unblock restores
cases.description: After Block, later messages neither show nor get a receipt, also after a restart; Unblock brings back the composer and new messages.

cases.title: Add to contacts
cases.description: Add to contacts opens the system form with the number filled in; after saving, the chat shows the new name.

cases.title: Phonebook sender gets no prompt
cases.description: A sender already in the phonebook opens straight to the composer.

cases.title: Group from a stranger gets no prompt
cases.description: A group started by a stranger opens normally; groups never show the prompt.

cases.title: Bot creates a group with the device
cases.description: The group appears after its first message, with the right name and the sender's label on the bubble.

cases.title: Sender labels: name vs number
cases.description: A saved contact is labelled with their phonebook name; a member not in the phonebook with their number.

cases.title: Replies in a group
cases.description: The device quotes a bot, a bot quotes the device, and the device quotes itself; every side sees the right parent.

cases.title: Bot reaction in a group
cases.description: A member's reaction on the device's group message renders under it.

cases.title: Same message id from another member
cases.description: A member message whose id equals one of ours in the same room still shows (it used to be dropped as our echo).

cases.title: Rename with emoji and a long name
cases.description: An owner's rename updates the chat header and the chat-list row.

cases.title: Member leaves
cases.description: When a member leaves, Group Info's member count drops.

cases.title: Group catch-up
cases.description: Group messages sent while offline (Android) or in the background (both) all appear on return, in order.

cases.title: Forward into and out of a group
cases.description: A group message forwards to a 1:1 chat (marked forwarded) and a 1:1 message forwards into the group.

cases.title: Device creates a group
cases.description: The device creates a group with two bots; both get the invite and the first message.

cases.title: Added mid-conversation
cases.description: A device added to an existing group receives the messages sent after it joined.

cases.title: Removed by the owner
cases.description: When the owner removes the device the group leaves the chat list, and later messages don't bring it back.

cases.title: Interleaved burst from three members
cases.description: 15 messages from three members in quick succession all arrive exactly once.

cases.title: 12 groups created while away
cases.description: All 12 are listed on return (discovery follows paging past 10) and none is dropped on the next reconnect.

cases.title: Empty group you were added to
cases.description: A group you're added to should appear before anyone writes in it.
cases.knownIssue: Hidden until the first message: the chat list requires a last message (README "Not fixed").

cases.title: Device leaves a group
cases.description: Leaving removes the row and the members see the device leave.

cases.title: First contact and presence
cases.description: The emulator finds the simulator user in its phonebook, messages them; the simulator sees it and shows the emulator as Online.

cases.title: Text both ways
cases.description: Each app's message reaches the other.

cases.title: Reply across apps
cases.description: The emulator quotes the simulator's message; the simulator sees the quote.

cases.title: Mixed group: two apps and two bots
cases.description: A bot creates a group with both apps and another bot; everyone sends and every app shows the right sender labels.

cases.title: Emulator offline catch-up
cases.description: The emulator goes into airplane mode while the simulator writes in the group; it catches up when back online.

cases.title: Simulator background catch-up
cases.description: The simulator app is in the background while the emulator writes; it catches up when foregrounded.

cases.title: Forward from one app to the other and to a bot
cases.description: The simulator forwards a group message to the emulator (Forwarded label) and to one of its own bots.

cases.title: Push notification opens the chat
cases.description: The Pixel is in the background; a message from the emulator raises a real FCM notification, and tapping it opens that chat.

cases.title: Samsung Wi-Fi drop and recovery
cases.description: The Samsung goes into airplane mode (Wi-Fi off too, see README); it misses a message and queues its own reply, then catches up and delivers once back online.

cases.title: Real keyboard keeps the composer visible
cases.description: On the Samsung, opening the keyboard leaves the composer and send button visible.

cases.title: Four-device group smoke
cases.description: Emulator, simulator, Pixel and Samsung: create a group, everyone sends, a reply, an offline catch-up.

cases.title: Pixel and iOS simulator 1:1 with offline
cases.description: The simulator starts a 1:1 chat with the Pixel (phones never get test contacts, so they only answer); the Pixel replies, then catches up on a message sent while it was in airplane mode.
